nodes.summary: Verification script that walks the doctrine directory and confirms each DOCTRINE_*.md has a matching parsed JSON file by reconstructing the expected JSON stem using the same id-derivation logic as parse_doctrine.py.
nodes.languageNotes: Reimplements parse_doctrine.py's id-derivation inline so the check stays independent; reports OK/FAIL counts to stdout.

nodes.name: extract_frontmatter
nodes.summary: Extracts the YAML-like frontmatter block (between leading '---' fences) from doctrine markdown text into a flat dict of key/value strings.

nodes.name: extract_title
nodes.summary: Returns the doctrine title from frontmatter when present, else falls back to the first H1 heading in the markdown body.

nodes.name: extract_id
nodes.summary: Derives the canonical doctrine id from frontmatter (id or doctrine_id) or, failing that, from the filename by stripping the DOCTRINE__ prefix and any trailing date and dot-normalizing the remainder.

nodes.name: extract_filed_date
nodes.summary: Returns the filed date from frontmatter, then from a '**Filed:** YYYY-MM-DD' body line, then from today's date as a final fallback.

nodes.name: extract_authority_level
nodes.summary: Maps a doctrine's status field (e.g., 'ratified', 'captured', 'draft') to an authority level string used by the canon index.

nodes.name: extract_depends_on
nodes.summary: Builds the depends_on list by reading the frontmatter depends_on field and by scanning the markdown body for 'Composes with' references and DOCTRINE_/SSU-/BUILDSPEC- citations.

nodes.name: extract_applies_to_roles
nodes.summary: Infers the applies_to_roles list by keyword-matching role names (vp, founder, scribe, oracle, executor, gate, etc.) against the lowercased doctrine body.

nodes.name: extract_key_rules
nodes.summary: Collects normative statements from the doctrine: section headings that read like laws/rules/gates and bolded short phrases inside the body.

nodes.name: parse_file
nodes.summary: Top-level per-file driver that reads a doctrine markdown path and composes a single structured node dict by calling every extractor in turn.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point: globs every DOCTRINE_*.md in the source directory, parses each into a JSON node file with a sanitized filename, and writes a consolidated DOCTRINE_INDEX.json summarizing the canon.
